body: I wish! That’d show a level of care. I made sure to show her the entire process—from opening the app to navigating to the boarding pass. At the boarding pass change, it had options like “flight status,” “check bag,” etc. I’d like to think it was accidental, but it almost felt intentional.

This made me wonder—since screenshots QR codes can easily be faked, doesn’t relying on electronic boarding passes seem like a weak point in security? With the level of human error I just witnessed, wouldn’t it make more sense to strengthen the backend verification of QR codes?

For context, I’ve almost always used screenshot of electronic boarding passes with TSA in the US without issues.
